translations.web: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
translations.bsb: If only darkness had taken that night away! May it not appear among the days of the year; may it never be entered in any of the months.
translations.kjv: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
translations.asv: As for that night, let thick darkness seize upon it: Let it not rejoice among the days of the year; Let it not come into the number of the months.
